title: Two-sided interval-verified optimality bounds for the PGLib-OPF v23.07 typical cases
description:
Computer-assisted proof candidate, not peer reviewed.

Lower and upper bounds L ≤ OPT ≤ U on the global optimum of the AC optimal power flow problem for all 26 typical-operating-condition cases of PGLib-OPF v23.07 (3 to 2000 buses), with machine-checkable certificates: Krawczyk interval-Newton enclosures for the upper bounds and sparse SDP/sum-of-squares dual certificates for the lower bounds, all checked with outward-rounded interval arithmetic. Includes independent checkers, a one-command replay script, replay records of all 52 endpoints on a second machine, and a short paper. AI assistance is disclosed in AI_DISCLOSURE.md. Licences: certificates, data and text CC BY 4.0; code (checkers, replay.py) MIT; PGLib-OPF case files CC BY 4.0 by the PGLib-OPF authors, unmodified.
